description: Auth routes that write credentials to the log aggregator. Express: the plaintext password from the login body, the freshly issued JWT and the raw Authorization header. FastAPI: the attempted password on a failed login (via Python's logger.warning) and the password-reset token, printed through a `token %s` placeholder. Flask: the submitted admin password read with request.form.get("password"). React: the stored session token printed with console.log(localStorage.getItem("token")) when the auth hook mounts. VC118 must fire on each.
